pr_title: Improve the usability of the editor timeline with combo colour and indices

issue_context.title: Editor timeline doesn't display (new) combos
issue_context.body:
Mainly opening these issues to discuss how these elements should be designed.

**Describe the bug:** 
Editor timeline should give a visual representation of new combo usage and combo count within combo. Right now all objects are white with no way to know what combo they belong to when looking at only the timeline.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
Lazer:
![osu_2020-04-26_21-19-14](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11320483/80315967-c20af980-8803-11ea-9541-d4d583cfe901.png)
Stable:
![screenshot182](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11320483/80315975-c7684400-8803-11ea-8791-40e344c2e76b.png)

**osu!lazer version:** 
2020.421.0

review_comments: Not sure if this was a conscious design choice but I feel at this size the numbers are pretty hard to see properly. How about something like 32? Although I do admit that size looks pretty silly on combo-index-less rulesets...
May need to change the font, not sure. Don't want to go bigger in size though, looks wrong even on osu! ruleset.
